### A New Thing
Author: Pastor Chuck Swindoll
Site: Insight for Living Ministries
URL: https://insight.org/resources/daily-devotional/individual/a-new-thing
Passage: Isaiah 43:19
Points:
- God frequently delights in surprising His people with unexpected interventions and fresh starts.
- A hurried or restless heart risks overlooking the quiet prompting and work of the Spirit.
- Biblical figures like Moses, Jacob, and Peter encountered surprising turns that redirected their lives.
- Even when current circumstances appear barren or hopeless, God's promise to forge a path remains dependable.
- Believers are urged to remain watchful and receptive, trusting that God has already begun His work.

### Why Did You Lead Me Here, God?
Author: Abby McDonald
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-april-22-2020.html
Passage: Isaiah 43:19
Points:
- Facing detours and obstacles after stepping out in faith does not mean God is absent.
- Obedience rarely guarantees that circumstances will align with our personal expectations or timelines.
- God perceives the complete trajectory of life and provides for deeper needs we easily overlook.
- The new work God brings forth often looks very different from what we predict.
- Believers can trust God to clear a trail through seasons of uncertainty and waiting.
